<!-- Generated by `chainmail docs`. Do not edit: change the command's help and run `go tool stave docs:commands`. -->

Print a script that teaches your shell to complete chainmail's commands,
flags and arguments, with descriptions. Completions that name accounts,
folders, labels, messages, attachments, secrets and watch groups ask the
daemon, so they need it running; when it is not, they offer nothing.

## Usage

```text
chainmail completion <bash|zsh|fish|powershell>
```

## Examples

```sh
# bash: add to ~/.bashrc
source <(chainmail completion bash)
# zsh: write it to a directory on $fpath
chainmail completion zsh > "${fpath[1]}/_chainmail"
# fish
chainmail completion fish > ~/.config/fish/completions/chainmail.fish
# PowerShell
chainmail completion powershell | Out-String | Invoke-Expression
```

## Global flags

```text
      --output string   output format: json or table (default $CHAINMAIL_OUTPUT, then cli.toml, then table on a terminal, json otherwise)
      --socket string   daemon socket (default $CHAINMAIL_SOCKET, then cli.toml, then /run/chainmail/chainmail.sock)
```
